name: cvcraft
description: Job-tailored CV builder for students (React + Express + MongoDB + Gemini)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
